comp.create.title: Create Component
comp.create.what: Makes a component at an entity (wired into At, or the one with this name), with keys like radius=160 capture_secs=8. If the spot is blocked (Unreal's Spawn Collision Handling): Always spawn, ignore collisions (Unreal's Always Spawn: it may get stuck); Try a nearby spot, but always spawn (Adjust If Possible But Always Spawn); Try a nearby spot, don't spawn if still blocked (Adjust If Possible But Don't Spawn If Colliding); Don't spawn if blocked (Do Not Spawn); or Retry every N seconds up to M tries (0: until it's clear). Nearby means within Max distance; Moved says it was moved. Outputs: Then goes on right away; Spawned once it exists, Failed once it gives up (Retry can make these come later); Entity, Success, Moved and Failure Reason (Blocked, Out of entity slots, Limit reached, Missing file, Retries used up, Bad input) let you try a fallback, like another spot. Where: At entity (its spot, moved by Local offset along its own forward, right and up; it faces the way the entity does if Face the way At entity faces is on, turned by Rotation offset) or At position. Rotation (pitch, yaw, roll) sets the facing outright (no Velocity or Scale: a component is a zone).

pins.help: At entity: an entity (a thing in the map). Optional.
At position: a position or direction (X, Y, Z). Optional.
Local offset (forward, right, up): a position or direction (X, Y, Z). Optional.
Rotation (pitch, yaw, roll): a position or direction (X, Y, Z). Optional.
Rotation offset: a position or direction (X, Y, Z). Optional.
Entity: a component entity (a Component handle).
Failure reason: why the spawn failed (none, blocked, out of entity slots...).

settings.help: Pick one: Capture point, Safe zone, Shrinking zone, Damage zone, Loot container, Weapon spawner, Supply drop, Wave spawner, Extraction point, Checkpoint, Trap, Respawn point….

creature.spawn.title: Spawn Creature
creature.spawn.what: Makes a creature of this type at an entity (wired into At, or the one with this name). Needs the Loner-Strike bot brain with creatures (the debugger says so if not). If the spot is blocked (Unreal's Spawn Collision Handling): Always spawn, ignore collisions (Unreal's Always Spawn: it may get stuck); Try a nearby spot, but always spawn (Adjust If Possible But Always Spawn); Try a nearby spot, don't spawn if still blocked (Adjust If Possible But Don't Spawn If Colliding); Don't spawn if blocked (Do Not Spawn); or Retry every N seconds up to M tries (0: until it's clear). Nearby means within Max distance; Moved says it was moved. Outputs: Then goes on right away; Spawned once it exists, Failed once it gives up (Retry can make these come later); Entity, Success, Moved and Failure Reason (Blocked, Out of entity slots, Limit reached, Missing file, Retries used up, Bad input) let you try a fallback, like another spot. Where: At entity (its spot, moved by Local offset along its own forward, right and up; it faces the way the entity does if Face the way At entity faces is on, turned by Rotation offset) or At position. Rotation (pitch, yaw, roll) sets the facing outright; Velocity starts it moving (a still thing then falls and slides); Scale sizes models and sprites.

npc.spawn.title: Spawn NPC
npc.spawn.what: Makes an NPC at an entity (wired into At), a point, or the entity with this name. Its model is loaded with the map (models/...mdl). If the spot is blocked (Unreal's Spawn Collision Handling): Always spawn, ignore collisions (Unreal's Always Spawn: it may get stuck); Try a nearby spot, but always spawn (Adjust If Possible But Always Spawn); Try a nearby spot, don't spawn if still blocked (Adjust If Possible But Don't Spawn If Colliding); Don't spawn if blocked (Do Not Spawn); or Retry every N seconds up to M tries (0: until it's clear). Nearby means within Max distance; Moved says it was moved. Outputs: Then goes on right away; Spawned once it exists, Failed once it gives up (Retry can make these come later); Entity, Success, Moved and Failure Reason (Blocked, Out of entity slots, Limit reached, Missing file, Retries used up, Bad input) let you try a fallback, like another spot. Where: At entity (its spot, moved by Local offset along its own forward, right and up; it faces the way the entity does if Face the way At entity faces is on, turned by Rotation offset) or At position. Rotation (pitch, yaw, roll) sets the facing outright; Velocity starts it moving (a still thing then falls and slides); Scale sizes models and sprites.

ent.spawn_prop.what: A model (models/...mdl, loaded with the map) at an entity's place; solid or not. If the spot is blocked (Unreal's Spawn Collision Handling): Always spawn, ignore collisions (Unreal's Always Spawn: it may get stuck); Try a nearby spot, but always spawn (Adjust If Possible But Always Spawn); Try a nearby spot, don't spawn if still blocked (Adjust If Possible But Don't Spawn If Colliding); Don't spawn if blocked (Do Not Spawn); or Retry every N seconds up to M tries (0: until it's clear). Nearby means within Max distance; Moved says it was moved. Outputs: Then goes on right away; Spawned once it exists, Failed once it gives up (Retry can make these come later); Entity, Success, Moved and Failure Reason (Blocked, Out of entity slots, Limit reached, Missing file, Retries used up, Bad input) let you try a fallback, like another spot. Where: At entity (its spot, moved by Local offset along its own forward, right and up; it faces the way the entity does if Face the way At entity faces is on, turned by Rotation offset) or At position. Rotation (pitch, yaw, roll) sets the facing outright; Velocity starts it moving (a still thing then falls and slides); Scale sizes models and sprites.

eng.score_color.what: Shows a player as a Terrorist, Counter-Terrorist or spectator in everyone's game (name color, scoreboard section) without moving them: their real team, spawns and rules stay. Real team undoes it. Side effects: the radar and name tags follow what's shown, and the player's own buy menu and team HUD do too.

ent.spawn_entity.title: Spawn Entity
ent.spawn_entity.what: Makes one of the game's entities with your keys (key=value pairs as in a map, | between them: model=sprites/glow01.spr|rendercolor=255 0 0|targetname=door_fx). Only classes that are safe to make while the game runs are listed: effects, sounds, markers, relays, pickups. Never players, worldspawn, game_* server controls or anything that runs commands. Files its keys name are loaded with the map; if one isn't on the server it's skipped, never a crash. Where: At entity (its spot, moved by Local offset along its own forward, right and up; it faces the way the entity does if Face the way At entity faces is on, turned by Rotation offset) or At position. Rotation (pitch, yaw, roll) sets the facing outright; Velocity starts it moving (a still thing then falls and slides); Scale sizes models and sprites. If the spot is blocked (Unreal's Spawn Collision Handling): Always spawn, ignore collisions (Unreal's Always Spawn: it may get stuck); Try a nearby spot, but always spawn (Adjust If Possible But Always Spawn); Try a nearby spot, don't spawn if still blocked (Adjust If Possible But Don't Spawn If Colliding); Don't spawn if blocked (Do Not Spawn); or Retry every N seconds up to M tries (0: until it's clear). Nearby means within Max distance; Moved says it was moved. pins.help: Near: a position or direction (X, Y, Z). Needs a wire.

settings.help: Pick one: Player standing, Player ducking, Large (big creatures), A point.
A number from 0 to 4096.

example.caption: When a round starts, Find Free Spot Near is read and printed to the server console.

player.language.title: Player Language

settings.help: Pick one: AMX Mod X (en, de...), The game (english...).
